intentional_fixture_changes: Current-version home/tester/profile fixtures use schema 12 while retaining original older input schemas, complete ownership checks and exact migration backups.

Nexus catalog tests retain exactly ten major gateways, now three released routes and seven unavailable activities; fresh Beastwilds remains locked behind earned depth 2 unless explicit local TEST ACCESS applies.
World registry retains all fourteen existing destinations and adds only the real Beastwilds world.
Native world camera fixture loads CameraRig after autoload initialization; assertions still require actual camera behavior.

Consumed egg replay checks physically revisit the source, require claimed/noninteractable/nontarget state, then directly attempt denial; they do not demand that a consumed source remain an interaction target.
Activity settlement preserves old statistics except the documented existing total_gold counter increase matching exactly secured Depthmarks.
All 49 foundation modes are retained; twelve distinct profile/reward persistence pairs and the new activity pair run as separate engine processes, plus the profile roundtrip reader.

resolved_development_findings: Preflight rejected an invalid grouped condition in Game and an inferred Variant in one test; both were fixed before runtime testing.
Native migration checks found Inventory model still admitted only profile versions 2–11. The narrowly approved two-line change adds 12 without changing any item or ownership rule.
The native camera fixture initially preloaded CameraRig before InputHub autoload registration; deferred loading corrected only the test.

Return/lifecycle fixtures initially expected consumed sources to stay targetable and total_gold not to record earned currency; stricter actual-state checks now preserve their intended anti-duplication assertions.

Review found revision-cap admission could reserve a run without room for settlement. Headroom guards now reject such admission, including interrupted-ticket recovery, and the native settlement test verifies the final permitted completion.

preserved_session_bodies.method: Exact declaration and indented function body, excluding trailing blank separators

separate_snapshot_scope_proof.authorization: Parent explicitly allowed retaining the prior native budget when only Session/ActivityProgress revision-headroom guards and tests differ; all other runtime, scene, resource, asset and project files must be byte-identical.

separate_native_budget_diagnostic.scope: Native Beastwilds scene-tree inventory includes actual fauna allocation/visibility, decorative wildlife, pose update intervals and process/light counts at all three presets. Scene-visible counts precede frustum/distance culling.

notes: All 119 modes use one frozen semantic snapshot, separate fixtures and unchanged protected baseline pins except the five explicitly scoped authorized files; inventory admission is constrained to the exact two-line version change; no diagnostic count is added to the accepted gate.
The separate native inventory measures scene-tree geometry and authored budgets only; it cannot establish Android frame rate, GPU memory or rendering quality.

Native geometry, player capsule, follower traversal, collision and both camera transitions are checked. Physical Android thumb reach, notch layout, visual flicker and sustained device performance remain manual.

Beastwilds supplies an earned local ingredient/discovery loop through the existing pet and inventory systems. Seven activity gateways remain unavailable. No direct pet capture, new masks, extra bosses, live multiplayer, ranking, guild or account authority is claimed.
No live marketplace, payment processing, hosting deployment or installation on a player device is claimed.
